kv15.11:3.3: Kusalena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo kusalo ti? Na h' evaṃ vattabbe --pe--

kv15.11:4.3: Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto ti?
kv15.11:4.6: adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto ti?
kv15.11:5.3: Akusalena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo akusalo ti?

kv15.11:6.6: adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto ti?
kv15.11:7.1: Kammaṃ cittena sahajātaṃ, kammaṃ sārammaṇan ti?
kv15.11:7.3: Kammūpacayo cittena sahajāto, kammūpacayo sārammaṇo ti?

kv15.11:13.4: "Idha Puṇṇa ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ pi abyāpajjhaṃ pi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti, sabyāpajjhaṃ pi abyāpajjhaṃ pi vacīsaṃkhāraṃ --pe--
kv15.11:13.5: manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti, so sabyāpajjhaṃ pi abyāpajjhaṃ pi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā, sabyāpajjhaṃ pi abyāpajjhaṃ pi vacīsaṃkhāraṃ --pe--
kv15.11:13.6: manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ pi abyāpajjhaṃ pi lokaṃ upapajjati,
kv15.11:13.7: tam enaṃ sabyāpajjhaṃ pi abyāpajjhaṃ pi lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhā pi abyāpajjhā pi phassā phusanti;
kv15.11:13.8: so sabyāpajjhehi pi abyāpajjhehi pi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhaṃ pi abyāpajjhaṃ pi vedanaṃ vedeti vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṃ, seyyathāpi manussā, ekacce ca devā, ekacce ca vinipātikā;
kv15.11:13.9: iti kho Puṇṇa bhūtābhūtassa upapatti hoti, yaṃ karoti, tena upapajjati; upapannaṃ etaṃ phassā phusanti.
kv15.11:13.10: Evaṃ pāhaṃ Puṇṇa kammadāyādā sattā ti vadāmīti."
